To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified cry-type genes on 20-kbp DNA associated with Cry 1 crystal proteins in Bacillus thuringienisis.
cry1Aa, cry1Ac, and cry2Aa genes were present on the 20-kbp DNA associated with Cry protoxins of a B. thuringensis soil isolate.
we isolated and analyzed 20-kb heterologous DNAs from a soil isolate of B. thurgiensis, and identified the cry-type genes on them.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cloning and expression of a cry1 gene in a heterologous host, and it will be of significance to the genetic manipulation of B. thurigiensis.
the identification of cry-type genes on 20-kbp DNA associated with Cry crystal proteins from a soil-isolate B. thuringienis strain 4-0718.
the cloning of the cry1Ac protoxin gene from B. thuringienis 4.0719, and its expression and characterization in B. thuringenisis 4Q7.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 20kb DNA associated with Cry protoxins of Bacillus thuringensis contains cry1Aa gene, cry1Ac gene and cry2Aa gene and cry2Ab gene.
the cry genes present on the 20-kbs are cry1Aa, cry1Ac, and cry2Aa and cry2Ab.
the 20- kb DNA fragment harbors cry1Aa and cry1Ac genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cry-type genes were present on 20kb DNA, and the genes could be expressed in B. thuringensis.

the 20 kb of DNA fragments harboring cry1 and cry2 genes were identified from a B. thuringienis strain 4-0718, and the cry1Ac genes was successfully cloned and expressed in an acrystraliferous B. Thuringiensis strain.

cry1Aa and cry2Aa genes were present on the 20-kbs associated with Cry1Aa and Cry1Aa/Cry2Aa crystals, respectively, and cry1Ac and cry2Ab were present on the same 20-kb associated with Cry1Ac crystals.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 20 kb DNA fragments from B. thuringensis strain 4.0178 contained cry1Aa, cry1Ac, and cry2Aa and cry2Ab.
the cry1Ac was expressed and the crystal was produced in the recombinant B. thuringienisis 4Q7.
the 20kb DNA fragments associated with Cry1A crystal proteins from B. thuringensis 4.0719 harbored cry1Ac and cry2Aa genes.
